propositions: The enrich drain gate check is O(ticket count) due to pending_enrichment scanning every ticket dir and calling reduce_ticket for each, causing 600-740 ms latency on every write against a 20 ms budget.
The gate's linear walk (24,000+ metadata syscalls per write) contends with itself under concurrent agent writes, amplifying latency to multiple seconds when multiple writers are active.
The budget-breach warning fires on 100% of writes, rendering it non-actionable for genuine future breaches (observability degradation).
An O(1) marker under .rebar/enrich-gate.json records the earliest instant any live entry can become pending, enabling fast-path returns when the store is provably quiet.
The fast-path marker self-heals: wrong markers only defer drains (never skip them), queue appends invalidate it, and a 10-minute TTL bounds crash windows.
